basic_info.description: Thoughtfully remodeled with a touch of Art Deco charm, this elegant condo is a true retreat in the heart of San Francisco. Set on a quiet, tree-lined block just steps from the action, this residence perfectly balances timeless charm w/ modern comfort. A striking bay window frames lush green outlooks over Collingwood St, creating a calm feel that makes you forget you're in the city. Sunlight filters through to highlight beautiful wood floors, spacious living/dining area anchored by a marble fireplace, & a tastefully remodeled kitchen w/stainless appliances & ample cabinetry. Two peaceful bedrooms w/ large closets share a luxurious remodeled bath. Additional features include in-unit laundry, independent parking with EV charging outlet, & exceptional storage - both a private locker and large shared area. Downstairs, a finished bonus room serves as a versatile common space for the HOA, ideal for a gym, office, or lounge area. The enchanting shared garden offers a tranquil outdoor escape w/mature landscaping, lemon tree, & bougainvillea. Perfectly situated where the Castro, Market St, Duboce and Mission Dolores converge, this condo offers effortless access to restaurants, shops, children's rec centers, Muni, & tech shuttles - the best of city living with a peaceful, tucked-away feel!
